messages:
nina: FYI — Nightingale AI sent their final draft for open-model onboarding. High-level asks: permissive redistribution of quantized weights to HW partners, ability for SI partners to rehost in managed clouds, and a co-announcement window. Can we surface any immediate red flags?

sofia: I skimmed the draft. Main legal concerns: export control classification, attribution, and a clause that currently allows downstream sublicensing without restrictions — we should tighten that. Need to know if they want a dual-license or single permissive license.

aj: Technical note — we need an explicit statement about which quantized formats they're ok with being redistributed (e.g., 4-bit/8-bit), and whether they permit further conversions. That affects our packaging for HW partners.

liam: From a product POV, bundling on cloud marketplaces is fine, but we need a versioning guarantee and a rollback plan in the contract (users will pin model SHAs). Also: can we require a small metadata header so our runtime can auto-detect quantization?

maria: For co-announcement, marketing needs a 2-week embargo lead and a single approved quote per org. Also confirm logos and which channels we can use (blog, tweet, cloud marketplace banner).

oliver: (Nightingale rep) quick clarifications: they said "rehosting allowed for distributions that don't modify model behavior." They worry about downstream derivative models. They prefer a permissive CLA but will accept a short reseller rider.

sofia: @oliver can you confirm whether "don't modify model behavior" excludes fine-tuning? If they intend to ban fine-tuning that breaks a lot of downstream use cases — need explicit language. Also ask them for a sample export classification (ECCN) or their counsel's input.

oliver: I'll ask counsel and confirm on fine-tuning. Tentatively they allow fine-tuning but want a notification clause for commercial re-offerings.

nina: Quick sync ask — can Eng produce a recommended redistribution clause snippet and a short list of formats we plan to support for packaging? We want to avoid back-and-forth.

aj: I'll draft a short technical appendix: supported formats + conversion policy. Example snippet: ```SupportedFormats: [q4_0, q4_1, q8_0]; Conversions allowed: yes, provided checksum preserved and metadata header added. No structural model surgery allowed.```

sofia: I'll draft legal-safe language for redistribution and reseller rider. Proposed line to negotiate: "Distributor may redistribute model binaries in quantized or otherwise optimized forms provided such redistributions include original attribution, do not create derivative models for resale without express written permission, and comply with applicable export laws." Thoughts?

liam: That reads well. Add a clause requiring semantic tests on redistributed weights (small eval suite) to reduce risk of misconfigured conversions releasing poor-quality variants.

maria: Also put a requirement that any co-branded announcement includes a 24-hour review window for quotes/assets. We can't have surprise claims.

nina: Timeline proposal: legal draft by EOD Wednesday, eng appendix by Thursday, partner counsel confirmation by Friday, then joint announcement sync next Monday. Anyone blocked?

oliver: Partner counsel might need 48 hours after my ask. Friday could be tight but doable.

sofia: Not blocked. Will push internal redline tracker and share comments in the doc.

legal-bot: Reminder: attach NDA and export checklist to the thread — https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/noda-export-checklist (automated)

nina: Perfect. If we get counsel confirmation on fine-tuning + ECCN by Friday, we can proceed with the reseller rider approach. Thanks all — I'll update the doc with action items. :thumbsup:

aj: I'll post the eng appendix draft in the doc in 2 hours.

maria: Saving the marketing checklist in the shared drive now.

oliver: Will ping Nightingale counsel tonight.

sofia: I'll queue the redlines and highlight the reseller/resale language.

nina: Closing loop — next update here Friday 16:00 PT.
